race.comment: PURGATORIO (9) is the one with upside off a solid maiden win at Ballarat, getting back but riding the fence and getting home strongly to beat a consistent one with good maiden form. He does have speed to roll forward and can do so here which will see him go close. POWER AND THE BEAT (2) resumes for his second campaign who showed ability last time in through some good 3yo races, watch the betting. GRIFTER (8) is lightly raced off a maiden win at Warrnambool and is in the mix again. INSAIN HARRY (3) has been okay in two runs back, he wasn't far away last time and gets every hope kicking up from the inside gate.
